name: incident-retrieval-repair
description: Incident retrieval schema repair — pgvector retrieval store that implements the spec, verified with pgTAP.

scripts.db:reset: psql -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS incident_retrieval_test" && psql -c "CREATE DATABASE incident_retrieval_test" && psql -d incident_retrieval_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migrations/001_retrieval_schema.sql && psql -d incident_retrieval_test -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgtap"
